new.s: The National Land Records Modernisation Programme (NLRMP), launched in 2008, was formed by merging which two earlier schemes?
o: Computerisation of Land Records (CLR) and Strengthening of Revenue Administration and Updating of Land Records (SRA&ULR)
National Generic Document Registration System and ULPIN
new.x: NLRMP (2008) merged CLR and SRA&ULR. SVAMITVA (2020) and NAKSHA are later schemes; NGDRS and ULPIN are DILRMP tools; Bhoomi (Karnataka) and Bhu Bharathi (AP) are State projects.

new.s:
With reference to the Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme (DILRMP), consider the following statements:
1. It has been a Central Sector Scheme with 100% central funding since 1 April 2016.
2. Digitisation of cadastral maps is one of its components.
3. It continues to be a Centrally Sponsored Scheme with cost-sharing by States.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct: DILRMP became a Central Sector Scheme with 100% central funding from 1 April 2016. Statement 2 is correct: digitisation of cadastral maps is a core component. Statement 3 is wrong: it was centrally sponsored earlier, before 2016. So B; A misses statement 2, C and D include statement 3.

new.s:
With reference to the progress under DILRMP, consider the following statements:
1. About 99.8% of Records of Rights have been digitised.
2. About 97.24% of cadastral maps have been digitised.
3. Less than half of the Sub-Registrar Offices have been computerised.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct: RoR digitisation is 99.8%. Statement 2 is correct: cadastral maps are 97.24% digitised (2026). Statement 3 is wrong: 95.73% of SROs were computerised in 2025-26. So B; A omits statement 2, C and D include statement 3.

new.s: SVAMITVA scheme is implemented under which Ministry, and of what type of scheme is it?
o: Ministry of Mines; Centrally Sponsored Scheme
Ministry of Panchayati Raj; Central Sector Scheme
Ministry of Rural Development; Centrally Sponsored Scheme
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; Central Sector Scheme
new.x: SVAMITVA belongs to the Ministry of Panchayati Raj and is a Central Sector scheme. The Ministry of Mines is a common trap; Rural Development handles DILRMP's Department of Land Resources, and Agriculture has no role in it.
new.tq: SVAMITVA = Panchayati Raj (not Mines), Central Sector.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about SVAMITVA:
1. Its target is 6.62 lakh villages at a cost of Rs 566.23 crore.
2. It has been extended to 2025-26.
3. More than 2.76 crore property cards have been prepared.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: the target is 6.62 lakh villages at Rs 566.23 crore, the scheme is extended to 2025-26, and over 2.76 crore property cards have been prepared (up from 2.42 crore in May 2025). So D; the other options omit a correct statement.

new.s: With reference to the QR-coded pattadar passbooks issued in Andhra Pradesh from January 2026, which one of the following is correct?
o: They carry the photograph of the Chief Minister and 81 lakh have been issued.
They carry the State emblem; 36 lakh have been issued and 56 lakh more are planned by March 2027.
They are issued only in the 7 mandals of the Mee Bhoomi-Blockchain pilot.
They replace Property Cards issued under SVAMITVA in urban areas.
new.x: From January 2026, AP issues QR-coded pattadar passbooks with the State emblem: 36 lakh issued, 56 lakh more by March 2027 covering 8,232 villages. 81 lakh is the parcel count of the resurvey; the 7-mandal pilot is Mee Bhoomi-Blockchain; SVAMITVA cards cover rural abadi areas, not urban.
new.tq: Passbooks: State emblem + QR; 36 lakh issued, 56 lakh by Mar 2027.

new.s: NABARD was set up on the recommendation of which committee?
o: Agricultural Credit Review Committee chaired by A.M. Khusro
Working Group on Rural Banks chaired by M. Narasimham
All India Rural Credit Survey Committee chaired by A.D. Gorwala
new.x: NABARD was recommended by CRAFICARD (Committee to Review Arrangements for Institutional Credit for Agriculture and Rural Development, 1979-81) chaired by B. Sivaraman. Khusro chaired the 1989 Agricultural Credit Review Committee, Narasimham the 1975 Working Group on Rural Banks (RRBs), and Gorwala the 1951-54 rural credit survey.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about NABARD:
1. It was established on 12 July 1982 under the NABARD Act, 1981.
2. Its headquarters is in Mumbai.
3. It was set up during the Seventh Five Year Plan.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct: NABARD was established on 12 July 1982 under the NABARD Act, 1981. Statement 2 is correct: its HQ is Mumbai. Statement 3 is wrong: it was set up in the Sixth Plan. So B; A omits statement 2, C and D include statement 3.
new.tq: NABARD: Act 1981, set up 12 July 1982, Sixth Plan, Mumbai.

new.s:
Which of the following funds are managed by NABARD?
1. Long Term Irrigation Fund (LTIF) under PMKSY
2. Warehouse Infrastructure Fund
3. Food Processing Fund
4. Micro Irrigation Fund
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
new.x: All four are NABARD funds: LTIF under PMKSY (Rs 1,441 crore), Warehouse Infrastructure Fund (2013-14, Rs 5,000 crore), Food Processing Fund (2014-15, Rs 2,000 crore) and the Micro Irrigation Fund. So D; the other options leave out a NABARD fund.
new.tq: NABARD funds: RIDF, LTIF, MIF, WIF, FPF.

new.s: The Kisan Credit Card scheme was launched in August 1998 as a model scheme of which institution, on the recommendation of which committee?
new.x: KCC (August 1998) is a NABARD model scheme based on the R.V. Gupta Committee. V.S. Vyas chaired the 2004 Advisory Committee on Flow of Credit to Agriculture, A.M. Khusro the 1989 Agricultural Credit Review Committee, and M. Narasimham the 1975 Working Group on Rural Banks.

new.s: Under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS), what interest subvention is given to lending institutions on short-term KCC crop loans?
new.x: Lenders get 1.5 per cent subvention. 3 per cent is the prompt repayment incentive to farmers, 4 per cent is the farmer's effective rate after it, and 7 per cent is the lending rate.
new.tq: MISS: 7% rate, 1.5% to lenders, 3% PRI, 4% effective.

new.s: The short-term cooperative credit structure of Andhra Pradesh (2025-26) consists of:
